name: Rhythm & Chord Change Essentials
instructions: Practice switching to and from your D chord slowly, aiming for a clean sound each time rather than speed.
Count out loud ("1-2-3-4") while strumming to build a steady internal sense of rhythm.
It is normal for chord changes to feel slow and clumsy for the first couple weeks -- muscle memory builds with repetition, not effort alone.
